text:
emma-sec: Automated scan found an archived debug bundle in partner staging that contains Vault ciphertexts tied to a deprecated KMS key version and a service account JSON. Starting containment.

raj-oncall: Path? I'll start blocking access.

emma-sec: s3://partner-staging-archive/agent-dumps/2026-07-18/debug-bundle.tar.gz

oliver-eng: Quick peek shows multiple `vault:v1:` transit blobs and an `agent-sa.json` inside. Risk: partner-retained copies + old KEK could allow offline unwrap.

tess-devops: Immediate actions I'll run:
```
# block public/agent access to bucket
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket partner-staging-archive --policy file://deny-agent.json
# revoke service account key placeholder
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete ABCDEF1234567890 --iam-account=agent-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

raj-oncall: Revoked token prefixes matching `agent-deploy-` and added short-lived Vault policy deny for `agent-debug` role. Also set S3 deny condition for older user-agents.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0721. Assigned: emma-sec, tess-devops, oliver-eng. Severity: medium.

emma-sec: We need a KEK rotation + rewrap. Oliver, can you coordinate rewrap and audit export? Compliance needs retention of audit artifacts.

oliver-eng: Plan: 1) create new KMS key version; 2) grant vault-proxy decrypt/encrypt on it; 3) dry-run `vault operator rewrap` for affected paths; 4) canary rewrap; 5) full rewrap if green. Will stream audit to gs://redwood-audit/INC-2026-0721/.

tess-devops: I'll open infra PR to create the key version and k8s job to run the rewrap with `--dry-run` first. Will include smoke tests and a 10-minute rollback window.

compliance-bot: Export configured and retention tag set per policy. Please attach partner deletion attestation.

partner-ops: We're searching for retained copies under our control and will scrub. ETA 90m for full sweep. We'll DM legal with attest once done.

emma-sec: Owners: emma-sec (coord + partner), tess-devops (infra + revoke), oliver-eng (rewrap + audit), raj-oncall (RBAC + monitoring). Close when audit export, partner attestation, and regression tests pass. :white_check_mark:
